name: Attempt Management
description: Provides an 'attempt' content entity type and a configurable field so any content entity can track per-user, per-entity attempts (e.g. quiz or SCORM tries).

suggests.drupal/scorm_field: Pairs with attempt_mgmt to record SCORM completion/score data per attempt.

project_description: Attempt Management provides an 'attempt' content entity type (attempt_mgmt_attempt) with a configurable bundle (attempt type), plus a field type (attempt_mgmt_attempt_settings) that can be attached to any content entity to give it attempt tracking. Each attempt records the host entity type/id, the user (or an anonymous session UUID), the attempt number, timestamps, computed duration, an IP, and temporary/closed flags. The attached field configures the behaviour per host: attempt type, limit (0-100), force-new-attempt, grading method (best/last attempt), display status, confirm delay, and lock-after-final-attempt. An AttemptFactory service exposes an API (create/update attempts, count attempts per user, check limits, close attempts) so other modules can integrate attempt management for their own use case. An AttemptProcessing annotation plugin type lets a module react to or validate attempts. It is a building block: on its own it adds the entity type and field but does not produce a quiz or course; scorm_field is the primary consumer, using it to record SCORM attempt results. Configure the site-wide confirm strings at /admin/config/system/attempt-management/settings; define attempt types at /admin/structure/attempt_mgmt_attempt_types.
